## Import



Controlcenter account factory baseline config can be imported using the customId(like uuid or base64 string), e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Controlcenter/accountFactoryBaselineConfig:AccountFactoryBaselineConfig example nMtrLC9IuQq27wyiICj9bA==
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
